_round: GR11 (P-017) finale, ending, crime-meter win, thanks

intro: Welcome to my rooftop, toads. Last stop before closing time.
My sign lights the whole harbor. Tonight, you two are the toast.
taunt: Stack 'em high, watch 'em fall. Like your little crusade.
Foam's up! Hope you two brought towels.
Spin cycle, sugarplums! Mind the mustache.
One eye's all I need to see you're beat.
hurt: My monocle! Do you know what squinting costs?
phase_end: Half-empty? Never! Fill her up in the truck!
Last call's on wheels, toads. Catch me if you can!

intro: Keys in, foam out! The whole harbor's my bar tab!
Ten tons of kegs and no brakes. Try and keep up.
taunt: Kegs away! Bowling night, harbor style!
Slick road ahead. Foam's my favorite pothole.
You drive like a Sunday ride-out, hon.
Three bumps won't stop a full delivery!
hurt: My paint job! That was fresh off the line!
Quit ramming my bumper, you warty menace!
phase_end: The truck's busted, but this brewmaster ain't!
Crawling out mad now. Somebody hand me a sign.

intro: No roof, no truck, no rules. Just me and a busted sign.
You wrecked my tower and my ride. Now I wreck you.
taunt: Broken sign, sharp edges. Dirty fighting is my brew.
I've got one eye and twice your nerve.
Hold still, I'll put you on a coaster.
This city ran on my tap. It'll run again!
hurt: That cane's harder than it looks, gramps!
Okay, okay, the curl's coming loose!
phase_end: Last round of the night. Make it count.
My knees are foam. Not done yet!

defeat: Fine! The tap is closed. Tell the harbor I'm cut off.
Splash! Ugh, the harbor's colder than my kegs.
You two... drink water. Stay out of trouble. Hic.
The one-eyed era is over. The stoops are yours, toads.

ending_cutscene: The last splash fades. The harbor goes quiet for the first time in years.
Harold leans on his cane. Mavis checks her purse. Still there.
A gray light creeps over the water. Night is finally giving up.
Up and down the rowhouse block, a window light clicks on.
Then another. Neighbors step out onto the marble stoops in slippers.
Somebody bangs a pot. Then everybody bangs a pot.
The water taxis blow their horns from every pier at once.
One by one, the landmarks light up along the shore.
The sun climbs over the skyline and paints every toad gold.
Mavis grabs Harold's arm. "Don't get mushy, hon. Get dancing."
The crime meter reads zero. The city reads home.
Harold and Mavis watch the sunrise. Tomorrow, the stoops need scrubbing.

clear_message: Inner Harbor is clear. Promenade's open all night now.
No thugs on the water. The paddle boats are back.
Fells Point is quiet. Even the ghosts went to bed.
Cobbles swept, pubs safe. Fells Point thanks you, hon.
Federal Hill is clear. Best view in town, crime-free.
Nobody's getting tossed off this hill anymore.
South Shore is safe. The Otters are just playing ball.
Key Highway's clear. Ride out, the road is yours.
Downtown West is clear. The market stalls stay open late.
No more cellar crooks. The basement lanes are bowling only.
Mount Vernon is clear. The monument shines tonight.
Marble steps, no mobs. Pull up a stoop and sit.

credits_thanks: Thanks for walking the harbor with us.
To every neighbor who ever scrubbed a stoop.
Thanks to the toads who never gave up.
For the night radio DJs keeping the city up.
Thanks for playing. Go call your grandparents.
For every block that bangs a pot at dawn.
See you on the promenade, hon.
